//: The service worker's own typecheck, run by npm run typecheck after tsconfig.json. src/public-runtime/service-worker.ts runs in a ServiceWorkerGlobalScope, whose WebWorker lib cannot share a program with the app's DOM lib, and it is type-stripped into public/sw.js by ops/scripts/frontend/build-public-runtime-scripts.ts rather than bundled. It is written as untyped JavaScript -- tests run slices of its source as plain JS -- so parameters and catch variables stay implicitly any, while everything the platform types (caches, events, Response, registration, clients) is checked strictly. moduleDetection lets the file declare its own self.
